metadata.philosophy: 3xR: Reuse, Refix, Recycle — Squeeze Every Cycle

nodes.name: MILHY-PC
nodes.role: Primary Workstation & Local AI Inference Node

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB Dual (GP106 Pascal) + Intel HD Graphics 4600
specs.os: MX Linux 25 (Debian 13 Trixie base, Linux 6.12 kernel, KDE Wayland)

gpu_topology.compute_acceleration: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB (Debian proprietary driver 550.163, APT pinned, nouveau blacklisted)
gpu_topology.vram_orchestration: Custom steam-gpu-wrap / vram-proton dynamic switcher (stops llama.service, frees 5.4GB VRAM for gaming, restores AI on exit)

workloads: Vibe Coding daily driver (Pi CLI, Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI)
Local LLM inference via llama.cpp / llama-server (Mistral / Qwen 7B GGUF)
Windows 11 VM (QEMU/KVM) for Codex Desktop & Perplexity Comet

nodes.name: HAS (Home Automation Server)
nodes.role: Central Automation Hub & MCP Orchestration Node
nodes.chassis_type: Repurposed headless laptop (internal battery serves as zero-latency built-in UPS)

networking.tailscale: Tailscale Mesh + Tailscale Funnel (secure zero-trust gateway for MCP endpoints)

workloads: 24 Docker containers managed via Portainer & Docker Compose
Mega-Orchestrator MCP cluster (filesystem, git, terminal, db, memory, qdrant vector backend, marketplace)

nodes.name: OptiPlex (formerly nicknamed LLMS)
nodes.role: Central Storage Cloud (Nextcloud), Coder Backend & Network Backup

specs.cpu: Intel Core 2 Quad Q9550 (4 cores, 12MB L2 cache, 2.83GHz)
specs.storage: 256 GB SSD (OS root) + 3 TB HDD (dedicated 'Backup' partition via Samba / SSH)
specs.os: Debian-based (MX Linux / pure Debian Headless Docker Host)

hardware_reality_lesson.no_avx_limitation: Core 2 Quad Q9550 lacks AVX / AVX2 instruction sets. Running modern LLM inference or heavy vector math results in instruction faults or severe performance cliff. Nickname 'LLMS' was an experimental artifact.
hardware_reality_lesson.architectural_pivot: Repurposed strictly as high-capacity NAS, Nextcloud repository, network backup server, and remote Coder container environment. Strict policy banning AVX-dependent workloads.

workloads: Nextcloud storage hub for lab files and personal documents

nodes.name: Acer Aspire Z5610 AIO (2010 Relic)
nodes.role: Bedside Media Center, Streaming TV & Ambient Status Terminal

specs.cpu: Intel Core 2 Quad Q9550 / E8400 upgraded silicon

thermal_engineering.problem: Upgraded desktop CPU caused severe thermal saturation in compact AIO chassis, hitting 82°C thermal shutdown.
thermal_engineering.solution: Custom Linux PowerManagement suite interfacing directly with CPU MSR (Model-Specific Registers) for dynamic frequency stepping and aggressive PWM fan curves.

workloads: Bedside streaming media playback (MPV / Kodi / browser)
Ambient system status dashboard & system telemetry

nodes.name: Raspberry Pi Dumb TV Dashboard
nodes.role: Low-Power Media Player, WebRTC Streamer & TV TUI

kernel_tuning.core_0: Isolated for network stack, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth IRQ noise
kernel_tuning.core_3: Locked for ALSA audio stack to eliminate dropouts and buffer underruns
kernel_tuning.cores_1_2: Dedicated to MPV media engine with dynamic 160% burst scheduling

workloads: go2rtc WebRTC / RTSP low-latency camera streaming

nodes.name: Travel Rig / Mobile Edge

specs.compute_node: Realme 8 5G (Android Linux kernel / Termux server mode)
specs.terminal_node: Intel Atom N270 Netbook (keyboard & display client)
specs.interconnect: Direct USB Tethering (RNDIS) forming a private offline 192.168.42.x subnet

nodes.philosophy: Zero-dependency mobile computing node capable of running diagnostics and shell tools anywhere without internet access.
